frontmatter.description: Release notes and deployment-relevant changes for akv2k8s 1.7

children.value: Akv2k8s 1.7 is primarily a build, release, and dependency update release. It does not introduce new
fields or change the documented runtime configuration from 1.6.
Starting with the 1.7 release series, akv2k8s container images are built for both
Use the normal image tags for the release, for example
. Container runtimes will pull the matching image variant for the node architecture.

The 1.7 release series also includes dependency and base image updates, including security fixes. Review the component image tags you deploy and upgrade all three components together unless you have a specific reason to pin them independently.
No Kubernetes custom resource migration is required when upgrading from 1.6 to 1.7. Existing
